row: DoveLewis is a nonprofit emergency and specialty animal hospital. DoveLewis provides donor-funded programs to the community, including one of the United States' largest volunteer-based animal blood banks, a nationally recognized pet loss support program, stabilizing care for lost, stray and wild animals, and financial assistance for qualifying low-income families and abused animals. Learn more at dovelewis.org.
